'''Stephen Comaty''' finished 18th of 21 players at the [[2008 Yavin 4 Regionals]] on 17 May 2008<ref name="sf-20194-302448">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302448#p302448 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20194-302401">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302401#p302401 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125180947/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start40.html Internet Archive]</ref> and played the Dark Side at the [[Cube]]-format [[2008 Maryland State Championship]] on 2 August 2008, where he finished fourth of the four Dark Side players.<ref name="sf-21815-320790">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=320790#p320790 MD States - Aug 2nd], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21815.html Internet Archive]</ref>
